eps.o: In this episode, legendary survivalist Matt Wright makes a dramatic entrance into the wilds of Florida’s Everglades.
Veteran survivalists Ky Furneaux and Dan Link take on their toughest challenge yet: surviving 14 days in Thailand with no tools at all.
In a first-ever episode, five social media influencers will attempt to use their primitive skills to survive for 14 days on a rugged, remote island in Thailand.
n unlikely duo must survive 14 days in Zambia, home to some of Africa's most dangerous wildlife.

eps.t: This Is Gonna Suck So Bad
eps.o: From Mexico's Yucatán to Botswana's Okavango Delta, fan favorites Ernie and Mandy return, this time for 21 days.
Two survivalists fight to endure 21 days of extreme dehydration in the drought-stricken Everglades.
A tropical paradise turns savage when two superfans battle pounding monsoon rains, poisonous fruit, and biting rats, as they try to survive 14 days on a remote Thai island.
Forced to trek two days to a water source, a laid-back hunter and an opinionated adventurer clash in Zambia, risking their 21-day challenge.
Haunted by their previous tap-outs, two survivalists seek redemption in Thailand's steep highland jungle.
For the first time ever, two survivalists are forced to spend the first night of their 21-day challenge completely alone in Botswana's, Okavango Delta.
A South African ranger and a Texan wilderness guide set out to prove they can survive 21 days in a remote Thai jungle.

Four survivalists attempt 21 days in the Kalahari Desert. But as brutal starvation sets in, desperation forces the group to confront fractured trust, extreme choices, and the limits of human endurance.
